LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING, ORAL EXPRESSIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Active Listening, Oral expressions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Active Listening, Oral expressions
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you ensure keenness when listening to texts?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify necessary vocabulary for learning
2. listen actively to texts for learning
3. appreciate the role of vocabulary in a language

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Active Listening, Oral expressions

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Active Listening, Oral expressions

Teach
• Focus skill: identify necessary vocabulary for learning.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Active Listening, Oral expressions.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Active Listening, Oral expressions
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you ensure keenness when listening to texts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
